data.one_liner: A library for adding water rippling effects to Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Adds a water rippling effect to any Flutter widget when touched by pointer, finger, or code. Supports simulating rain drops falling on widgets and wrapping images, videos, buttons, or tables.
use_when: You want to add interactive water ripple effects to widgets or images
You need to simulate rain drops falling on UI elements programmatically
avoid_when: You need standard material ripple effects without a custom water simulation
strengths: Can be applied to any Flutter widget or image
Supports interaction via pointer, finger, or code (e.g., simulating rain drops)
Cross-platform support including android, ios, web, windows, macos, and linux
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic examples and algorithm attribution
No advanced customization details explicitly documented
